queries.result: First-party discovery found Preston City Council's Planning Public Maps and local land-charge search, and HM Land Registry guidance for property/title plans, index-map searches, and MapSearch. No anonymous Preston parcel-vector endpoint was found.

registryEvidence.custodian: HM Land Registry is evidenced as the England-and-Wales national land-registration custodian; Preston City Council is evidenced as a local planning/local-land-charge authority, not as an open cadastral parcel-data custodian.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: The official sources document title plans, index-map searches, planning maps, and local land charges, but no anonymous Preston parcel feature service or local cadastral registry endpoint was qualified. registryFound remains null.

officialSources.observation: Official Preston City Council page describes a public planning map for planning applications, conservation areas, and listed buildings; it is not identified as a cadastral parcel feed.
Official council local-land-charge search procedure; it requires a property/land search request and does not expose parcel geometry.
Official HM Land Registry overview states that title plans show property location and boundaries and describes register/index-map procedures.
Official HM Land Registry MapSearch guidance says the service can view registered land and title numbers, but requires a Business e-services portal account.

source: Preston City Council planning/local-land-charge services and HM Land Registry England-and-Wales services

requestOutcomes.outcome: First-party search result described the public planning map and its planning-layer scope; no parcel schema or download endpoint was exposed.
TLS-default request reached the official host but was blocked by Cloudflare challenge. No bypass was attempted; current JavaScript/configuration and service URL could not be inspected.
First-party search evidence identified the official local-land-charge request workflow; no anonymous parcel geometry or native parcel identity was returned.
Official HM Land Registry overview retrieved; it describes title plans and index-map searches, not a public parcel vector API.
Official MapSearch guidance retrieved; it confirms registered-land map viewing and title-number access, but states that portal access requires a Business e-services account.
The official MapSearch route is account-gated. No login, credentials, or private/unsafe fields were requested.

geometryEvidence.reason: No unchanged anonymous native parcel geometry response was received.
